hooks.command:
if command -v rebar >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && rebar check --cold-start; elif [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cold-start-checks.sh" ]; then "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/cold-start-checks.sh; else printf '<rebar-cold-start>
rebar not found in PATH — install rebar to get cold-start checks
</rebar-cold-start>
'; fi
